Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files and demanding ransom payments
Exfiltrating files before encrypting systems to extort victims
Creating leak sites to post stolen victim data
Using open-source DiskCryptor to encrypt files and writing custom boot loader to master boot record (Mamba)
Remote desktop credentials purchased from underground forums (less elaborate actors)
Complex distribution models, spear-phishing, and lateral movement (Ryuk and Sodinokibi)
Attacking smaller managed service providers (MSPs) and large enterprises
Corrupting data upon encryption and delivering buggy decryption tools (Mesponinoza, DeathHiddenTear, Buran)

Purchasing remote desktop credentials from underground forums
